messages:
Sam R: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need a tight action list and owners for DR playbook gaps discovered during the outage. Keeping this short so we can spin up tasks.
Ivy L: Yes please. Main patterns we saw: cache cold-starts, slow restores, and intermittent DNS propagation flaps.
Sam R: Actions I propose: 1) Restore runbook rewrite with explicit approval gate + rollback commands (owner: Ivy, due 2026-04-04). 2) Snapshot integrity & restore-timing audit (owner: Ben, due 2026-04-07). 3) Cache priming step + small traffic-replay for rehearsals (owner: Ben, due 2026-04-08). 4) Non-disruptive BGP dry-run + comms checklist (owner: Sam, due 2026-04-09). 5) Add SLI: "restore wall-clock" <=45m 90p and track in dashboard (owner: Platform Eng, due 2026-04-12).
Ben K: I'll run the snapshot audit. Plan: sample restores across clusters, capture wall-clock times, CSV export, and flag any >45m. Also will record variance by size.
Ivy L: I'll take the runbook. I'll add: explicit pre-checks, manual approval phrasing, failback verification steps (DNS propagation checks, route table asserts, cache validation). ETA 2026-04-04.
Sam R: For BGP dry-run I want manual promotion for first two rehearsals. We'll practice withdraws on test prefixes and verify path re-announcements. I'll draft the comms script.
Ben K: I'll add a post-restore cache-validation step to the audit and wire a small replay script at /ops/dr/replay.
ops-bot: reminder: link owners to JIRA epic and create child tickets for each action.
Sam R: Agree manual promotion. Also add exact rollback CLI snippets in the runbook (who runs them and confirmation phrasing).
Ivy L: Example CLI I'll include: 
```
# failback quick check
dig +short @8.8.8.8 service.example.com
curl -s http://internal-health/route-check | jq .ok
```
Ben K: Will include restore time measurements and proposed retention policy diffs. If snapshots are missing retention, I'll recommend policy alignment.
Sam R: Recap and closure goal: create JIRA epic, schedule dry-run (late March), complete runbook + audit, add cache priming and SLI tracking. Reconvene 2026-04-10 for signoff.
Ivy L: ACK, will link runbook doc to the epic when ready.
Ben K: ACK, will post CSV and timings.
Sam R: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
